query: Who was the US president in 2016?
answer:
Barack Obama, a Democrat, was president for all of 2016. He was the 44th president and served two terms, from January 20, 2009, to January 20, 2017 [1]. Donald Trump won the November 2016 election, but he didn't take office until January 20, 2017 [1].

Sources:
[1] Presidency of Barack Obama – Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Presidency_of_Barack_Obama
